summary: Frontend testing completed for Edit Customer modal alignment with Add Customer form. All 10 test cases passed. Edit modal now has accordion structure (Basic Information, Other Information, Tags & Flags, Notes), Customer Type uses radio buttons, inline corporate fields appear with orange background when Corporate is selected, and all new fields are present.
critical_code_review_comments: Edit Customer modal correctly implements accordion structure matching Add Customer form
Customer Type field uses radio buttons (Normal/Corporate) as expected
Inline corporate fields appear within Other Information section with orange tinted background (rgba(242, 107, 51, 0.05))
All corporate fields present: GST Name, GST Number, Billing Address, Credit Limit, Payment Terms
Tags & Flags section has VIP, Complaint, Blacklist toggle switches
Notes section has textarea for customer notes
Full address fields present: Address Line 1, Line 2, City, State, Pincode, Country, Delivery Instructions
Country code dropdown uses full COUNTRY_CODES list (8 options)
Edit and save functionality works correctly
seed_data_creation: Modified existing customer 'Test Normal 6017' to 'Test Normal Edited 6101' with city 'Mumbai'. Created regression test customer 'Regression Test 6435'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Edit Customer modal alignment is complete. Add Customer modal also works correctly.
